class.name: QuickBarComponent
class.brief_description: A row of slots pointing at inventory items, one of them active and equipped.
class.description: The active slot's item is put on through the pawn's [EquipmentManagerComponent] (when it has an [InventoryFragmentEquippableItem]); selecting another slot takes it off first. Put it beside the [InventoryManagerComponent]. Under a [PlayerController] the pair outlives the pawn, and the active item is put on again whenever the controller possesses a new one; under a pawn root it equips on that pawn. The server decides. A client calling [method set_active_slot_index] or [method swap_slots] sends the request to the server and sees the result when it comes back; the slots reach the owner only. An item that leaves the inventory leaves its slot too. [codeblock] func _on_slot_key(index: int) -> void: quick_bar.set_active_slot_index(index) # works on the host and on the owning client [/codeblock]

method.name: add_item_to_slot
method.description: Server: puts an item of the inventory into an empty slot.

method.name: client_receive_state
method.description: RPC: the slots and the active index, sent to the owner.

method.name: cycle_active_slot_backward
method.description: Selects the previous slot holding an item, wrapping around.

method.name: cycle_active_slot_forward
method.description: Selects the next slot holding an item, wrapping around.

method.name: find_slot_of_item
method.description: The slot holding the item, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_active_slot_index
method.description: The active slot, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_active_slot_item
method.description: The active slot's item, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_equipment_manager
method.description: Where the active item is put on: the possessed pawn's when this sits under a controller, else the one beside it.

method.name: get_equipped_item
method.description: What the active slot has on - available wherever the equipment replicates.

method.name: get_inventory
method.description: The inventory the slots point into.

method.name: get_next_free_item_slot
method.description: The first empty slot, or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_slot_item
method.description: The slot's item, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_slots
method.description: One entry per slot: the [InventoryItemInstance], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: is_item_slot_free
method.description: Whether the slot exists and is empty.

method.name: is_mirror
method.description: True on the owning client, whose copy follows the server's.

method.name: remove_item_from_slot
method.description: Server: empties a slot, taking its item off first if it was active. Returns the item.

method.name: reset_slots
method.description: Server: empties every slot and selects nothing.

method.name: server_request_full_state
method.description: RPC: the owner asks for the slots.

method.name: server_set_active_slot_index
method.description: RPC: the owner asks to select a slot.

method.name: server_swap_slots
method.description: RPC: the owner asks to swap two slots.

method.name: set_active_slot_index
method.description: Selects a slot and puts its item on; [code]-1[/code] selects nothing. Selecting the active slot again changes nothing. On a client this is a request to the server.

method.name: swap_slots
method.description: Swaps two slots' items; the active index stays where it was, so the item in the hands changes when the active slot takes part. On a client this is a request to the server.

members.member: Whether [method set_active_slot_index] with [code]-1[/code] (nothing in the hands) is allowed.
On the server, an item arriving in the inventory with an [InventoryFragmentQuickBarIcon] or an [InventoryFragmentEquippableItem] goes into the first free slot by itself.
The inventory whose items the slots point at. Empty uses the first [InventoryManagerComponent] beside this node.
Whether the owner gets a mirror. Off, every peer keeps its own, as offline.

signal.name: active_slot_changed
signal.description: Another slot was selected; [code]-1[/code] is none.

signal.name: slots_changed
signal.description: A slot's item changed - or, on a client, an item a slot names has just arrived.
